run_merge_annotations: run the script to merge 4 shard pseudo mask JSON files into a single COCO annotations JSON
merge_coco_pseudo_masks: merge multiple pseudo mask shard files into one COCO-format annotations JSON with reindexed IDs
reindex_annotation_ids: reassign unique incrementing IDs to annotations collected from multiple pseudo mask shard files
combine_mask_shards: combine 4 split mask shard JSON files into a single merged output JSON file
replace_coco_annotations: replace the annotations array in a reference COCO JSON with merged pseudo mask annotations
